title: Second Home vs Investment Property: Mortgage Rules in SC
description: Second home vs investment property: how lenders decide, whether you can rent out a second home, and what the difference does to your down payment and taxes.
h1: Second Home vs Investment Property: Which Mortgage Do You Need?
dek: Buying a beach place you'll use and rent out sometimes? Here's how lenders decide.

about.name: Second home and investment property mortgages

faq.q: How many days do you have to live in a second home?
faq.a: Fannie Mae's second home rule doesn't set a number of days. You must live there for some part of the year, and the home must be livable year-round.

faq.q: Can I use rental income to qualify for a second home?
faq.a: No. If you need the rent to qualify, the loan is an investment property loan. A DSCR loan, which qualifies you on the rent, is one option.

faq.q: Is a second home taxed more in South Carolina?
faq.a: Yes. A legal residence is assessed at 4% of its value when the owner applies. A second home is assessed at 6%.
